test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech.

He said, "Let me do it myself."

options.text: He asked to do it himself.
He requested that he do it himself.
He asked to be allowed to do it himself

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He asked to be allowed to do it himself.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Let me do it myself" becomes "to be allowed to do it himself"**
 
 
• The imperative "Let" is converted into a request "to be allowed."
 
• Pronoun "me" is changed to "himself" to match the indirect speech perspective.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "He asked"
 
• Maintains the tone of a polite request.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is transformed into a clear indirect speech sentence.
 
• Quotation marks are removed, and the sentence is reconstructed in indirect speech style.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *He asked to be allowed to do it himself.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "He asked to do it himself."

 
 
• Missing the idea of being allowed, altering the meaning.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "He suggested doing it himself."
 
 
• Changes the tone from a request to a suggestion, altering the intent.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "He requested that he do it himself."
 
 
• Does not fully express the idea of asking permission.
